hibernate-mapping.sql-query: select s.*, count as responseCount from mr.surveys s, mr.responsecount r where s.id = r.id and s.account_id= :account_id

SELECT (vwtotals.pr_fn::text || ' '::text) || vwtotals.pr_ln::text AS prac_name, sum(vwtotals.num) AS count FROM vwtotals WHERE date_part('month'::text, vwtotals.updated_at) = :month_selected AND date_part('year'::text, vwtotals.updated_at) = :year_selected GROUP BY (vwtotals.pr_fn::text || ' '::text) || vwtotals.pr_ln::text ORDER BY (vwtotals.pr_fn::text || ' '::text) || vwtotals.pr_ln::text

SELECT u.id, vp.projecttitle, vp.prac_first_name AS pracfname, vp.prac_last_name AS prac_lname, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.status, u.created_on, u.updated_at, date_part('month'::text, u.updated_at) AS billing_month, vp.costcode FROM app_user u, vwprojects vp WHERE vp.id = u.project_id AND u.oldreport = false AND date_part('month'::text, u.updated_at) = :month_selected AND date_part('year'::text, u.updated_at) = :year_selected ORDER BY vp.prac_last_name, u.created_on DESC
